findings.title: The projector has no way to select a 20-query audit from a growing retained corpus.
findings.body: project() includes every latest active unique query and then rejects anything other than exactly 20 with 10 positives. Corpus instructions require retaining valid history and appending new queries, and Pass H asks for fresh queries. After a corpus has 20 still-valid queries, adding one newly discovered valid query makes the documented projector command fail. The code has only --check and no audit-set selector. Retiring a still-valid row merely to fit the cap would conflict with the scoped history/scope-retirement guidance.

evidence.quote: rows = [...] for row in latest.values(); if len(rows) != 20 ... raise ValueError
Append new query/verdict records ... Retain history. ... Project only the selected active queries
Replay applicable existing queries before adding a fresh 10-positive/10-negative audit set.

findings.corroboration: Second read of the cited spans and synthetic copied-projector fixture: 20 active rows exit 0; preserving them and appending one valid unique row exits 1 with the recorded ValueError. All six projectors have SHA256 39636b95ce9ca11513db91bbca7d8ee38cfc8ce23363fb3efc8c8ebdeaa30b98.
findings.severity_criterion: Medium: reduces robustness of the named repeat-run/history-maintenance workflow without unsafe source mutation. The failing command and input transition are concrete.
findings.recommendation: Define an explicit deterministic audit-set selection separate from retained query history, and have project_triggers.py project that selected 10+10 set. Preserve historical rows and scope-retirement provenance.
findings.disposition: Reported only. No repair or loop was run.

findings.title: The shared mapping freshness gate requires an operator-action row.
findings.body: The final shared contract preserves its historical mapping-table date of 2026-06-11 and explicitly says it is not a fresh verification. On the review date 2026-11-11 that date is 153 days old. Frozen Pass A requires a Medium freshness finding after 90 days and permits a BLOCKED/operator-action disposition instead of an in-loop research detour. The current artifact already directs this disposition; this review records it and does not assert the underlying claims are currently wrong or re-verified.

evidence.quote: Historical mapping-table check: 2026-06-11 ... This date is not a fresh verification. Emit a BLOCKED/operator-action row when that gate is due.

evidence.criterion: A stamp older than 90 days is Medium, resolvable by a BLOCKED/operator-action row.

findings.corroboration: Second read of final contract lines 10-15 and deterministic date subtraction: 153 days.
findings.severity_criterion: Frozen Pass A explicit >90-day Medium calibration.
findings.disposition: BLOCKED/operator-action: re-verify volatile claims through separately authorized source research; keep the date unchanged until that happens. This is an acknowledged external-evidence limit, not a newly demonstrated factual defect.

findings.title: Extra blank lines before entrypoint headings.
findings.corroboration: Deterministic repeated-blank-line scan; 7 extra blank lines across 5 entrypoints. No trailing whitespace, tabs, configured invisible characters or CRLF were found in the six entrypoints.
findings.severity_criterion: Pass L hygiene, excluded from Medium+ convergence totals.
